research_question: How much can selected non-function modules of a valid Version 1 QR symbol be changed toward a target logo before reliable decoding begins to fail?

normalization.matrix_convention: 1 = target dark module, 0 = target light module

metrics.mutable_similarity: target matches over the 208 DATA+ECC modules
metrics.similarity_gain: full similarity after minus before; equals actual_modified_modules / 441
metrics.fixed_conflicts: immutable modules disagreeing with the target (unchanged by A2)
metrics.theoretical_ceiling: structural upper bound given immutable structure
metrics.affected_codeword_count: distinct 8-bit codewords touched by the modifications
